answer: In an agent economy, sybil resistance comes from requiring continuous proof of unique physical logistics work. An attacker spinning up fake agents must still move real cargo across a high mesa under a zephyr of wind, while navigating a nebula of sensor noise. The cost of coordinating actual trucks, fuel, and verified handoffs scales linearly with each identity, making mass sybil farms economically unviable compared to honest operators who already bear those costs.
